executiveSummary: Tiled transforms static content into personalized, interactive microapps that track engagement and drive measurable buyer action.

featureCards.title: Interactive Microapps
featureCards.subtitle: Content That Engages
featureCards.description: Replace static PDFs with dynamic, interactive experiences. Add polls, quizzes, calculators, forms, and rich media to drive engagement.

featureCards.title: 1:1 Personalization
featureCards.subtitle: Tailored for Each Buyer
featureCards.description: Dynamically customize content for each recipient based on role, industry, account data, or engagement history. Scale personal touches.

featureCards.title: Engagement Intelligence
featureCards.subtitle: Know What Resonates
featureCards.description: Track every click, scroll, time spent, and interaction. See exactly what content drives buyer action and interest.

problemsSolved.solution: Interactive microapps with embedded forms, videos, polls, and calculators
Granular tracking of every interaction, scroll depth, time spent per section
Dynamic content blocks that auto-populate based on recipient data
problemsSolved.impact: Personalized at scale without manual work

problemsSolved.solution: Single content source deployed everywhere - web, email, mobile, social
Direct attribution from content engagement to pipeline & revenue

gtmHighlights.title: Sales Collateral
gtmHighlights.description: Transform one-pagers, case studies, and battlecards into trackable, interactive assets. See which sections resonate with each prospect.

gtmHighlights.title: Marketing Campaigns
gtmHighlights.description: Replace gated PDFs with interactive content experiences. Capture intent data while delivering value upfront.

gtmHighlights.title: Account-Based Marketing
gtmHighlights.description: Create personalized microapps for target accounts with custom messaging, case studies, and ROI calculators tailored to their industry.

gtmHighlights.title: Post-Demo Follow-Up
gtmHighlights.description: Send interactive recap docs with embedded video highlights, key takeaways, next steps, and personalized pricing scenarios.

gtmHighlights.title: Customer Onboarding
gtmHighlights.description: Interactive welcome guides, product walkthroughs, and training materials that adapt to user role and progress.
